children.text: Effects that do not fit come in switched off (#1515, owner's R1 and R2, 2026-10-31). When the rig comes up over the effects budget (a restore, a reopen, a session load, fewer effects workers than it was saved with), chains are switched off until the rest fits: chains the player already had off first, then the newest stage (lane chains, then track, All tracks, output and input chains). Every chain keeps its entries and its saved switch; nothing is deleted and the switch-off is never saved, so a rig with more room brings everything back. This banner names the chains that were on. It is a banner, not a toast, because the sound differs from what was saved until the player acts, and it uses the warning amber, not the record red: nothing is lost. It stands until every chain it names is back on, or Dismiss (the chains stay off). Turning one on is refused with the over-budget message until it fits. One notice per cause: a take whose copied chains do not fit while this banner stands joins it instead of a toast (see 21 / effects off take toast). It sits under the device-lost banner when both stand: two causes, two strips.
